nodes.label: Settings Window Click Crash Fix Implementation Plan
Main Thread Window Construction
nodes.rationale: Settings AppKit and WKWebView mutations are moved into Tauri setup so they execute in main-thread context rather than on a Tokio worker.

nodes.label: Checked Main Thread Marker
nodes.rationale: Replacing unchecked marker construction with a checked expectation turns accidental off-thread use into a contained task panic instead of a WebKit process crash.

nodes.label: Post Drag Focus Restoration
nodes.rationale: The visible settings window is refocused after main-window drag or resize completes so its controls do not become unresponsive.

nodes.label: Platform Native Window Move Observers
nodes.rationale: macOS NSWindowDidMoveNotification and Windows WM_EXITSIZEMOVE fire only at the intended user-driven boundary and avoid a focus-change feedback loop.

nodes.label: Settings Panel Empty Area Drag Implementation Plan
Settings Panel Empty Area Drag
nodes.rationale: A root pointer handler lets non-interactive panel space start native dragging without changing Rust window lifecycle or layout.

nodes.label: Interactive Drag Target Classifier
nodes.rationale: Buttons, inputs, links, role buttons, and explicitly marked regions must remain interactive and therefore suppress window dragging.

nodes.label: Pomodoro Main Window Fit Panel Implementation Plan
Fixed Size Pomodoro Main Host
nodes.rationale: The main Tauri window is reduced to a non-resizable 249 by 171 host containing only the 233 by 155 Pomodoro panel plus eight-pixel edges.

nodes.label: Native Passthrough Removal
nodes.rationale: Once the main window exactly fits its interactive panel, the DOM hit-region registry and native transparent-region passthrough are obsolete, while settings first-mouse and focus helpers remain.

nodes.label: Shared Settings Apply Overlay
nodes.rationale: A single floating Apply row is rendered by SettingsPanel only when the active section has pending ordinary changes.

nodes.label: Ordinary Apply Metadata Lifting
nodes.rationale: Tabs report dirty, canApply, and apply metadata upward so the overlay is reusable and no tab reserves layout space for it.

nodes.label: Settings Content Area Scroll Implementation Plan
Content Area Scroll Ownership
nodes.rationale: The settings-content-scroll element is the only vertical scroll viewport and is explicitly prevented from horizontal scrolling.

nodes.label: Fixed Clipped Settings Shell
nodes.rationale: Root, scale wrapper, body, and content containers remain fixed-height and clipped so document-level scrolling cannot compete with the intended content area.

nodes.label: Active App Logo And Title Display Implementation Plan
Active App Logo And Title Display
nodes.rationale: Foreground application icons are converted to PNG data URLs and the independent input-counter panel can prefer the native window title or fall back to the app name.

nodes.label: Persisted Window Title Visibility
nodes.rationale: Native Rust remains responsible for collection while React settings, persistence, and bridge snapshots own the display policy across windows.

nodes.label: Input Counter Panel Regression Implementation Plan
Enabled Binding Visibility Gate
nodes.rationale: The native input-counter window is visible only when the panel is enabled and at least one enabled entry has a captured input.

nodes.label: Lightweight Bridge Snapshot
nodes.rationale: High-frequency count-only snapshots omit active-app icon bytes, while initial and active-app-change snapshots retain them, reducing bridge payload cost.

nodes.label: Shared Scaled Window Sizing
nodes.rationale: A common Rust resize command and frontend hook apply settings.uiScale consistently to the main, settings, and input-counter windows.

nodes.label: Monitor Clamped Geometry
nodes.rationale: Pure geometry helpers validate positive finite dimensions, clamp scaled sizes to monitor bounds with an edge margin, and optionally recenter windows.

nodes.label: Silent Signed Background Updates
nodes.rationale: The stable channel uses official Tauri updater verification to check, download, and install in the background with guarded scheduling and persisted opt-in state.

nodes.label: Manual Restart After Install
nodes.rationale: Installation stays low interruption and never restarts automatically; a ready notice asks the user to relaunch after the update is prepared.

nodes.label: Remote Player Card Window Pool
nodes.rationale: The main window owns seven fixed remote-player card slots for the non-local members of an eight-player room, and persists native positions by playerId.

nodes.label: Active App Multiplayer Payload
nodes.rationale: Room protocol and state sync carry each player's active app window title and icon data URL through authoritative server normalization and bridge snapshots.

nodes.label: Persisted Autostart Setting
nodes.rationale: The off-by-default setting is owned and persisted by the authoritative main window, then mirrored through the existing bridge.

nodes.label: OS Login Startup Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Startup compares the persisted preference with the real macOS or Windows registration exposed by the official Tauri autostart plugin and persists only confirmed state.

nodes.label: Daily Check-in Domain
nodes.rationale: A focused main-window store models weekly plans, inherited days, rest days, daily records, analysis selectors, persistence, rollover, and idempotent Pomodoro completion linkage.

nodes.label: Mirrored Check-in Windows
nodes.rationale: Independent today-checkin and checkin-editor Tauri windows render Pencil-aligned mirror stores while dispatching mutations to the authoritative main window.

nodes.label: Key Counter Listener Health Implementation Plan
Key Counter Listener Health
nodes.rationale: Rust ListenerHandle becomes authoritative for startup success, last error, timestamps, and process identity diagnostics and emits health changes to the frontend.

nodes.label: Permission and Health Separation
nodes.rationale: Accessibility permission and actual event-listener operation are distinct states; the settings banner appears only when permission exists but the listener is not running and offers a safe retry.

nodes.label: Typed Input Identity
nodes.rationale: Keyboard codes and left, middle, or right mouse buttons share one discriminated input identity while legacy keyCode records remain countable and migratable.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Mouse Hooks
nodes.rationale: One native listener lifecycle emits typed input-pressed events from CoreGraphics taps on macOS and low-level keyboard and mouse hooks on Windows.

nodes.label: Remote Player Card Follow-up Implementation Plan
Remote Binding Key Normalization
nodes.rationale: The card trims labels, clamps counts, hides invalid pills, and relies on the existing RemoteState.bindingKey plus bridge snapshot path instead of introducing another WebSocket event.

nodes.label: Pencil-aligned Player Card Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: The pin button moves inside the content stack so its containing block and key-counter pill match the accepted Pencil hierarchy.

nodes.label: Account Auth Status Reset Implementation Plan
Post-auth Network Idle Reset
nodes.rationale: Authentication may open the WebSocket as transport setup without entering a room, so successful or terminal auth results return connection status to idle when no playerId exists.

nodes.label: Room Action Busy Overlay
nodes.rationale: The online panel busy overlay is defensively scoped to logged-in room actions so account creation and login cannot display a misleading joining-room message.

nodes.label: Account Login Room Gate Implementation Plan
Logged-in Room Control Gate
nodes.rationale: Room and history controls render only after mirrored account state is logged in, while account errors remain retryable and user-facing codes are translated.

nodes.label: Startup Session Restoration
nodes.rationale: The authoritative main App restores a saved account session once at startup before the settings mirror can offer authenticated room actions.

nodes.label: File-backed Auth Store
nodes.rationale: The server stores normalized users and sessions atomically, hashes passwords with salted scrypt, and issues opaque session tokens rather than persisting plaintext credentials.

nodes.label: Authenticated WebSocket Rooms
nodes.rationale: Auth messages extend the existing WebSocket protocol and attach identity to each connection; create_room and join_room require that identity while local Pomodoro and check-in features remain independent.

nodes.label: Auto Pin On Focus End Implementation Plan
Auto Pin On Focus End
nodes.rationale: A persisted, default-on global preference controls whether a natural focus-to-break transition automatically enables the main-window pin.

nodes.label: Pomodoro Pin Action
nodes.rationale: App observes focus-end events and calls the Pomodoro store setPinned action once, allowing the existing panel effect to remain the sole native pin-command bridge.

nodes.label: Check-in Editor Panel Drag Implementation Plan
Check-in Editor Panel Drag
nodes.rationale: Non-interactive areas of the editor root start native window dragging with the existing Tauri window API and need no CSS, Rust, capability, or builder changes.

nodes.label: Shared Drag Target Filter
nodes.rationale: The app's existing shouldStartWindowDrag rule rejects non-primary buttons and targets such as buttons, inputs, selects, and marked no-drag regions.

nodes.label: Check-in Editor Pixel Sync and Icon Editing Implementation Plan
Pixel-synced Check-in Editor
nodes.rationale: Pencil node s6g1w is updated first, then the static HTML dev-align prototype is synchronized and visually verified before its structure and styles move into React.

nodes.label: Editable Check-in Icons and Metrics
nodes.rationale: Check-in items gain selectable currentColor SVG icons and editable per-use metrics, while the editor enforces at most one Pomodoro-focus item per day.
